standard.summary: 每隔 N 个 epoch 暂停训练让 GPU 降温，防止长时间高负载导致过热降频或硬件损伤。
standard.effect: cooldown_every_n_epochs=3 表示每 3 个 epoch 暂停一次。cooldown_minutes=10 表示暂停 10 分钟。cooldown_until_temp=0 表示使用固定时间而非温度阈值。
standard.whenToUse: 长时间训练（几天/几周）时保护 GPU。散热条件差的环境。
standard.avoidWhen: 训练时间短时不需要。暂停会中断训练节奏。

standard_en.summary: Pauses training every N epochs to let the GPU cool, so a long stretch at full load does not cause thermal throttling or hardware damage.
standard_en.effect: cooldown_every_n_epochs=3 pauses once every 3 epochs. cooldown_minutes=10 pauses for 10 minutes. cooldown_until_temp=0 means a fixed time rather than a temperature threshold.
standard_en.whenToUse: Protecting the GPU during long runs (days or weeks), or in a poorly ventilated environment.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed for short runs; the pauses do break the rhythm of training.

advanced.principle: cooldown_until_temp > 0 时启用温度驱动：每 cooldown_poll_seconds 检查 GPU 温度，直到温度降到目标值以下才恢复训练。pause_enabled/pause_every_epochs/pause_duration_minutes 是另一种暂停方案。gpu_power_limit_w 可以通过降低功耗限制来控制温度（需要 root/admin 权限）。
advanced.intervention: 训练循环中每 N epoch 插入暂停逻辑 → 等待降温 → 恢复训练。
advanced.expectedImpact: 防止 GPU 过热降频。保护硬件寿命。
advanced.tradeoffs: 暂停期间 GPU 空闲。总训练时间增加。

advanced_en.principle: cooldown_until_temp > 0 enables temperature-driven cooling: every cooldown_poll_seconds the GPU temperature is checked and training only resumes below the target. pause_enabled/pause_every_epochs/pause_duration_minutes are a separate pause scheme. gpu_power_limit_w can control temperature by lowering the power limit (needs root/admin).
advanced_en.intervention: The training loop inserts a pause every N epochs → waits for cooling → resumes training.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Prevents thermal throttling. Protects hardware lifespan.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The GPU idles during pauses; total training time increases.
